members.title: Former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon enters witness box in Sydney double murder trial
members.lead: Lamarre-Condon gives evidence in court after pleading not guilty to murdering Jesse Baird and Luke Davies in early 2024 Live updates: Beau Lamarre-Condon gives evidence in murder trial Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Former officer Beau Lamarre-Condon has alleged he heard homophobic abuse when working for New South Wales police, as the 31-year-old gave evidence in his double murder trial in Sydney. Lamarre-Condon is accused of fatally shooting couple Jesse Baird and Luke Davies with his police service weapon in Baird’s Paddington home on 19 February 2024. Continue reading...

members.title: Beau Lamarre-Condon trial live updates: accused double murderer gives evidence in high-profile case
members.lead: Lamarre-Condon tells court Baird told him he ‘wasn’t ready for a relationship with anyone’ Lamarre-Condon tells the court he met with Baird on 17 April 2023 and told him he had read the messages between Baird and the other man. The former officer said: I told him this made me feel a bit upset because we were moving towards – I guess being a couple. Jesse was honest with me [and] became emotional and started crying, said he wasn’t ready for a relationship with anyone not just me. Lamarre-Condon said he was looking for something more serious and needed a few weeks away to “let my romantic emotions settle”. He told the court Baird then said: “Please let me know when you’re ready to hang out again. I would like to have you back in my life and see you.” Lamarre-Condon said the situation was “very amicable”.
